Accessory: WOWPC Recovery USB
 Operating System: Windows 11 Pro 64 Bit
 Processor: intel Core i3-1315U
 (Processor) Number of Physical Cores: 6 Core, 8 Thread
 (Processor) Base Speed 3.3 GHz
 (Processor) Turbo Speed: Up to 4.5 GHz
 (Processor) Cache: 10MB
 RAM: Up to 64GB
 Storage: Up to 2TB (PCIe-NVMe)
 Graphics: Integrated: Intel Graphics
 Display: 15.6" diagonal, FHD (1920 x 1080), IPS, narrow bezel, anti-glare, 250 nits Wireless: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth
 Optical Drive: DVD±RW
 Ports:1x SuperSpeed USB-C 10Gbps, 2x SuperSpeed USB-A 10Gbps, 1x Headphone/microphone combo, 1x HDMI 1.4 Output, 1x RJ-45, 1x Audio-out
 Audio: Dual stereo speakers, dual array microphones

 Dimensions L x W x H (inches): 14.09 x 9.53 x 0.78 Inches
 Built-in HD Webcam: HD 720p
 Weight: 4 LB

items.label: 【Powerhouse Performance】
items.value: Unlock seamless multitasking with the Core i3-1315U processor, beats i5-1135G7 featuring 6 cores, 8 threads, and turbo speeds up to 4.5 GHz, paired with integrated Intel Graphics for accelerated visuals.

items.label: 【Immersive Visuals】
items.value: The 15.6" Full HD (1920 x 1080) IPS display with an anti-glare surface and 250 nits brightness delivers vibrant and lifelike visuals, ensuring a captivating viewing experience.

items.label: 【Operation System】
items.value: Experience the intuitive and productivity-focused Windows 11 Pro 64-bit operating system, designed with streamlined multitasking capabilities and advanced security features.

items.label: 【Versatile Connectivity】
items.value: Stay connected with a range of ports, including USB Type-C and Type-A for high-speed data transfers, HDMI for multimedia, and a fingerprint reader for secure access.

items.label: 【Seamless Support】
items.value: The included WOWPC system recovery USB ensures a hassle-free troubleshooting experience, enhancing the overall user experience.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, Fingerprint Reader, HD Audio, Numeric Keypad

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: External displays, mice, keyboards, storage devices, printers, and other accessories designed to interface with the notebook's ports (e.g., USB, HDMI, Thunderbolt) or wireless connectivity options (e.g., Bluetooth, Wi-Fi)
